case_analysis.apparent_benchmark_claim: The case appears to claim success for importing each markdown file from ~/documents/personal/notes/ into Simple Note as a separate note, with titles derived from the filename basename by replacing underscores with spaces.
case_analysis.actual_checked_outcome: The released machinery loads the same task spec and ground truth, compares the task-input start DBs against the retained experiment end DBs, and marks success exactly when all six registered tests pass: answer matches null; changed model names equal {simple_note.Note}; changed_records for simple_note.Note has zero updated and zero removed records; and added-note titles, contents, and title-to-content mapping match private_data.note_title_to_content under ignore_case/strip normalization. The dynamic test.task_completed assignment is not a scored test.
case_analysis.target_construction_review: private_data.note_title_to_content is the concrete target used by the evaluator for the imported notes, and it is consistent with the start-state markdown corpus. I found no retained-source basis for a different target construction than the note-import outcome the task text suggests.
case_analysis.evaluator_oracle_review: The evaluator only scores requirements registered inside with test(...) blocks, so test.task_completed is excluded from passes/failures/success. The evaluator is weaker than the surface instruction on exact title/content fidelity because it ignores case and surrounding whitespace when comparing imported notes to the target mapping.
case_analysis.reward_wiring_aggregation_review: There is no separate per-record reward predicate beyond TestTracker.success: the official worker serializes the tracker, the released label is derived from tracker.success, and Metric only computes later aggregates without changing an individual record's success.

official_benchmark_assessment.description: The official evaluator operationalizes the same note-import outcome but more weakly than the instruction surface because title/content checks ignore case and surrounding whitespace, while test.task_completed is not itself scored.

checklist_and_case_packet_assessment.description: The frozen checklist and case packet preserve the six official registered tests, keep native conjunctive, exclude the unscored task_completed assignment, and place the stricter exact-import condition only in stronger.
